claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: whether the RECOMMENDED product remedy (a) — strip the redaction placeholder from the answer prose before the product's own probe planner — repairs the probe-anchor bounded cause on the pinned recorded bytes of the accepted 14-bundle population, under four frozen gates (G1 no placeholder token in any FIXED anchor; G2 topical FIXED anchor on every baseline-contaminated bundle; G3 byte-for-byte no-op on every clean-anchor bundle; G4 FIXED anchors equal the accepted record 39674402905's published G4 de-redacted anchors). It is a REPAIR VERIFICATION computed offline from committed bytes with zero network calls: the FIXED probes are never executed against OpenCaseLaw, so it is NOT a counter-authority recall measurement, NOT a live-retrieval measurement, NOT a label-emission measurement, NOT a measurement of the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates, NOT a claim about LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND (both stay REPORTED-ONLY), NOT a claim about jurist usefulness or the map, and NOT a serve recommendation. It lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; packet admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready and owner_decision_required stay false. It does NOT authorise the product lane to skip re-measuring after it lands the fix: when the product bytes change, this freeze's product pins drift and a NEW freeze under a NEW run id must verify the shipped planner itself. No universal-174k benchmark is run and no product source file is modified by this instrument.

C1_baseline_reproduces_recorded_probes.description: the BASELINE arm (product's own planner on the bundle's own recorded prose) reproduces every recorded probe query byte-for-byte, so the measurement is faithful to the shipped behaviour

C2_blank_prose_yields_no_plan_in_both_ar.description: after the remedy, a prose consisting only of the placeholder still yields NO probe plan (the product's D4 vacuity guard is restored for placeholder-only prose), and a blank prose yields none in the BASELINE arm

C3_repair_target_exists.description: at least one measured bundle has a BASELINE placeholder-contaminated anchor, so the repair target still exists on the pinned bytes (non-vacuity)

C4_fix_is_noop_without_the_placeholder.description: for every bundle whose answer prose contains no redaction placeholder, the FIXED arm is a byte-for-byte no-op — the shim's own placebo arm

C5_fix_does_not_kill_probe_emission.description: every bundle whose BASELINE arm emitted at least one probe plan still emits at least one under the FIXED arm

frozen_rule: per bundle with recorded adversarial probes: BASELINE arm = product.plan_adversarial_queries(query, prose); FIXED arm = product.plan_adversarial_queries(query, prose with every REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER occurrence replaced by a space), i.e. the evaluation-side emulation of the recommended product remedy (a). Gates: G1 holds iff every FIXED anchor (first ANCHOR_SLOTS whitespace tokens of the first FIXED probe query) contains no token of the product's own answer_key_terms(REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER); G2 holds iff on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is contaminated the FIXED anchor shares at least one question content term under the product's own pool rule (len >= 6, not in _ANSWER_STOP, not a digit); G3 holds iff on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is NOT contaminated the FIXED arm issues byte-for-byte the same probe query list as the BASELINE arm; G4 holds iff on every bundle whose row exists in the accepted record 39674402905 the FIXED anchor equals that record's published G4_counterfactual.de_redacted_anchor byte-for-byte. The run verdict is REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES iff all four gates and all five controls pass and all pins hold; REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT_ON_RECORDED_BYTES iff at least one gate fails while all controls and pins hold; ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS iff any control fails, any pin drifts before or after execution, the population is empty, or zero accepted-record rows are G4-comparable. All comparisons are set/list equality on the product's own tokenisation: there is NO count, rate, frequency, share or percentage threshold anywhere in the rule, and none may be introduced after the result is seen.

G1_no_placeholder_token_in_fixed_anchor.description: the FIXED arm's topic anchor contains no token the product's own answer_key_terms extracts from the redaction placeholder, on every measured bundle

G2_fixed_anchor_topical_on_contaminated_.description: on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is placeholder-contaminated, the FIXED anchor shares at least one content term (product pool rule) with the question it is supposed to attack

G3_fixed_is_noop_on_clean_anchor_bundles.description: on every bundle whose BASELINE anchor is NOT contaminated, the FIXED arm issues byte-for-byte the same probe queries as the BASELINE arm — the remedy must not perturb working probes

G4_fixed_matches_accepted_counterfactual.description: the FIXED arm's anchor equals, byte-for-byte, the G4 de-redacted anchor published by the accepted falsifier record 39674402905, on every bundle where that record published one — two separately committed computations of the remedy must agree

39319405429 de with 9 and anchor [citation, removed, retrieved, nicht]), and its per-bundle G4 de-redaction counterfactual arms, from which the G2 prediction follows directly: the published de-redacted anchors are [fürsorgepflicht, arbeitgeber, nicht, pflicht] and [nicht, fürsorgepflicht, arbeitgeber, bvger], both carrying the question content term fürsorgepflicht, while all twelve other bundles published de_differs=False (the counterfactual is a no-op on them); (2) the accepted falsifier's product_handoff naming remedy (a) — exclude the redaction placeholder from the probe key terms in product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py — as the recommended fix and stating remedy (b) (plan from pre-redaction prose) alone is insufficient if the answer lacks legal vocabulary; (3) that the product mount's current shipped planner (product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py, sha256 57b6a6f9...) still contains the unfixed `probe_terms = [t for t in key_terms[:4]] + terms` reading the raw post-redaction prose, i.e. the fix has NOT landed; (4) a local reproduction of the accepted falsifier on the pinned mount (run id local_verify_39687372110, results/evaluation/counter_probe_anchor_falsifier/local_verify_39687372110.json) reproducing the accepted verdict, the same 14 bundles, the same 2 contaminated bundles and the same anchors — a reproduction of accepted EXPLORATORY evidence, not a new claim; (5) a --selftest run of this instrument on SYNTHETIC prose only (loader works; a synthetic placeholder-heavy prose yields a contaminated BASELINE anchor and a clean topical FIXED anchor; a clean prose is a no-op under the fix; placeholder-only prose yields a plan in the BASELINE arm and none in the FIXED arm, reproducing the D4 restoration), which by construction never touches the real bundle population and never writes a result file. No repair-verification measurement on the real population, no gate outcome, no control outcome and no result file existed at the moment of this freeze.
verdict_statement: on the pinned recorded bytes of the accepted 14-bundle population, the recommended remedy (a) repairs the probe-anchor bounded cause: every FIXED anchor is free of placeholder-derived tokens (G1), both baseline-contaminated German anchors regain a topical anchor (G2), the twelve clean-anchor bundles are byte-for-byte unperturbed (G3), and every FIXED anchor equals the accepted falsifier record 39674402905's published G4 de-redacted anchor (G4), with all five controls held. This is a repair VERIFICATION on recorded bytes, not a live-retrieval or counter-authority-recall measurement.
